brief: Dādī and the knotted-cord spirit at a low table: on a clay slate a ladder of written numbers and a circle of a day cut into eight slices, half bright and half dark; Śuka looking at the slate; Dādī pointing.
The library at morning: the knotted-cord spirit holding up a book and a question mark made of rope; Dādī tapping a shelf, Śuka whispering to you; sunbeams crossing the rows of books.

Four small scenes along the ghat steps: a boy reading, a girl writing on a slate, a heron standing, a boat gliding; Śuka on Dādī's shoulder squawking happily; the small spirit counting on his fingers.
Śuka the parrot flapping happily as word-cards float in the air around him, the small grey-blue spirit juggling them, Dādī clapping on the ghat steps.
